name: 2D Basketball🏀
desc:
IMPORTANT: This game was made by a huge fan of basket random, it is a fan-made unofficial version of basket random

Play basketball against people but in 2d⛹️
- NO P2W, NO ATTRIBUTES, PURE SKILL🔥
- Don't want to learn a grocery list of keybinds? I gotchu, to play 2D Basketball, only one is needed🕹️
- Buy celebrations in shop, and spin effects to flex on people lol

CONTROLS (to jump and shoot):
PC💻️ = [LMB] or [SPACE]
CONSOLE🎮️ = [R1], [R2] or [A]
MOBILE📱 = TAP
Double jump to short jump
